from solution import version_selection
assert version_selection('2.1.0;1.9.9,2.1.1,2.0.5')=='2.0.5'
assert version_selection('1.0.0;2.0.0')==''
assert version_selection('1.0.0;1.0.0,1.0.0') is None
assert version_selection('01.0.0;1.0.0') is None
assert version_selection('1.0;1.0.0') is None
assert version_selection('1.0.0;') is None

import re
def version_selection(s):
 p=s.split(';')
 if len(p)!=2 or not p[1]:return None
 def v(x):
  q=x.split('.')
  return tuple(map(int,q)) if len(q)==3 and all(re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*',z) and int(z)<=1000000 for z in q) else None
 c=v(p[0]);seen=set();best=None
 if c is None:return None
 for x in p[1].split(','):
  q=v(x)
  if q is None or q in seen:return None
  seen.add(q)
  if q<=c and (best is None or q>best):best=q
 return '' if best is None else '.'.join(map(str,best))
